definitions.explanation: A barbed hook for catching fish, tied to a fishing line. From {釣|つ}る (to fish) plus {針|はり} (needle, hook).

examples.japanese: {釣|つ}り{針|ばり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{餌|えさ}→餌：01886_esa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: To put bait on the fishhook.

examples.japanese: ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{釣|つ}り{針|ばり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: A fish got caught on the hook.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{釣|つ}り→釣り：03439_tsuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していたら→する：00392_suru⟧、{釣|つ}り{針|ばり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っかかって→引っかかる：12455_hikkakaru⟧しまった。
examples.english: While fishing in the sea, my hook got caught on a rock.

notes:
From ⟦{釣|つ}る→釣る：01236_tsuru⟧ (to fish) plus ⟦{針|はり}→針：03566_hari⟧ (needle, hook); ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ voices to ば in the compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {釣|つ}り{針|ばり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{餌|えさ}→餌：01886_esa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to bait a hook
- {釣|つ}り{針|ばり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: to be hooked / to take the bait
- {釣|つ}り{針|ばり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to remove the hook

USAGE:
{釣|つ}り{針|ばり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧ is also used figuratively to mean 'to fall for a trick or lure'.
